tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
tidecaller.what: A blade of living sea water on a coral hilt; the edge rolls like a wave and bubbles rise through it

crystal_cleaver.name: Crystal Cleaver
crystal_cleaver.what: A broad blade grown from one purple crystal, all facets, a prism glint running up it

bonecrusher.name: Bonecrusher
bonecrusher.what: A two-handed maul of bone, a giant’s skull for its head, green ghost fire in the eyes

kingslayer.name: Kingslayer
kingslayer.what: A black two-handed sword with a jagged edge, red runes that burn and fade, a chain round the grip

mothwing.name: Mothwing
mothwing.what: A pale lilac knife with a moth’s wings for a guard; they beat, and silver dust falls

serpents_kiss.name: Serpent’s Kiss
serpents_kiss.what: A wavy green sword whose guard is a snake’s head; its tongue flicks

ghostblade.name: Ghostblade
ghostblade.what: A sword that is only a ghost of one: pale and hollow, wisps trailing from its edge

clockwork.name: The Clockwork Wand
clockwork.what: A brass wand with gears at its head that turn, and a little spring of sparks

prism_spire.name: Prism Spire
prism_spire.what: A white staff; above it a prism turns in the air and throws a fan of rainbow light

watchers_eye.name: The Watcher’s Eye
watchers_eye.what: A gnarled black staff ending in a claw that holds a great eye; it looks about, and blinks

dragonbone.name: Dragonbone
dragonbone.what: A bow of bone with a dragon’s skull at its top and its tail at the bottom; embers drift from the jaws

blossomstring.name: Blossomstring
blossomstring.what: A bow of pink wood in flower; petals fall from it as it moves

wolfs_fang.name: Wolf’s Fang
wolfs_fang.what: A great white fang for a blade, a grip of grey fur, a paw for a pommel
